## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] No code copied from other multiplayer mods (learning from behaviour is fine; copying is not).
- [ ] No game files committed.
- [ ] `dotnet test WinterMP.NoGame.slnf` passes locally.
- [ ] Core and Server still have no Unity or game references.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` for anything a player or server operator would notice.
